test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

The fisherman asked his contractor if those salmons were to go on that morning’s fish train.

options.text: The fisherman said to his contractor, “Are those salmons going on that morning’s fish train?”
The fisherman said to his contractor, “Are these salmons to go on this morning’s fish train?”
The fisherman said to his contractor, “Were these salmons to go on that morning’s fish train?”
The fisherman said to his contractor, “Is those salmons to go on this morning’s fish train?”

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is__ **The fisherman said to his contractor, “Are these salmons to go on this morning’s fish train?”**__
